note: Follow-on to 0216. The consolidated chain (0055–0061) and the smoke fixture were already split out; this moves the rest of the pre-0150 arc into archive so active dogfood is the recent tip.

decisions.question: Should pre-0150 dogfood decision files stay in the active rebuild?
decisions.commitment: No. Every decision file numbered below 0150 moves to docs/archive/decisions/ and is excluded from dogfood_store.py rebuilds. Active dogfood keeps the 0150+ arc (open IDEAS threads and recent shipped work). Historical rows remain in git and in tests/fixtures/dogfood_smoke/ where the manifest names them.
decisions.why: After 0216's smoke fixture and consolidated archive, the active queue still carried ~350 rows of closed history. Verify and rebuild are cheap; the cost was cognitive — agents treating the whole corpus as live dogfood. Cutting at 0150 leaves a bounded active tip without deleting audit record.
